name: Integrated Plant Sciences PhD entry program
detailsNote: Fall 2027 deadline confirmed. Rotation and direct-entry paths coexist; no single admission model assigned.
tracks: Warnell School of Forestry & Natural Resources

deadlines.label: Guaranteed consideration
deadlines.note: For Fall 2027; contact program before late application.

timeline.interviews: Brief Zoom interview in January; guide specifies mid-January versus web early January. Recruitment visit February 25–27,2027, travel/lodging/meals covered.
timeline.decisions: Offers following interview and recruitment process.

applicationFee.note: Current central fee $75 first / $25 additional; department pages still show old $100 international. Limited waivers only qualifying-program participants with uploaded evidence; overseas eligibility must be confirmed.

english.note: IELTS every band at least 6. TOEFL new-scale policy applies on/after January 22, 2026; no January 21 rule inferred. Agency reports, MyBest/Home Edition and IELTS Online/One Skill Retake accepted. UGA English Level 6 alternative; DET not accepted. Usually exempt after a degree from an accredited US institution or institution in a primary-English country. At least one current year of US accredited study with strong performance (for example GPA 3.0) may also support waiver. Departments may still require testing; TA English rules are separate.

documents: Personal statement written in applicant own words
requirements.note: Choose IPS PhD Fall major, and rotation or direct-entry path. Three 5-week first-fall rotations or lab direct entry. Identify 3 PhD units, 3 interdisciplinary groups, 5 faculty. Contact faculty encouraged. Recommendation count not stated in opened program instructions.

funding.note: First-semester assistantship, no teaching obligation. Years 2–5 stipend guaranteed at chosen program standard; no amount given. Tuition waiver for all in Year 1, continues while RA/TA-supported; home program may require teaching.
